gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-akatab: Bellota Text looks like glass tubing bent into letters, with open, unshaded curves that give it a distinctive presence. And Akatab follows in round, cupped sans shapes that feel approachable, leaving the big, short headlines to Bellota Text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alan-sans: Neon-tube strokes of uniform thickness give Bellota Text its look. Alan Sans, a plain sans with curve tails held well back from the body, keeps a longer passage feeling modern and professional.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans keeps its apertures open even at tiny sizes, with strokes that hold one thickness in every direction. Bellota Text earns its keep above it, big and short, where its commanding, shade-free curves can show off.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alef: Bellota Text draws open, commanding letters with no calligraphic swelling anywhere along their outlines, which makes it distinctive. Alef, a modern sans-serif, can be sized to taste.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota Text outlines every counter in a single steady line. Alegreya Sans SC, a contemporary sans with a welcoming gap in its c, makes a longer passage feel modern and inviting.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-almarai: Commanding is how Bellota Text comes across, with open, unshaded curves that stand out at a glance. Almarai keeps a clean, professional line that never swells or tapers beneath it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-amarna: Bellota Text bends open, unshaded curves into a distinctive, commanding shape. Amarna's contrast-free strokes and unclogged little counters keep a longer passage clean and contemporary to read.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-andika: Bold tubing-like curves, nothing shaded. Andika, a plain sans with tails and terminals as thick as its stems, and easy, wide turns in its s, keeps a longer passage modern and professional.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-antic: Antic looks drawn with one nib, its open letter mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined, giving a professional, contemporary sans-serif feel. Bellota Text brings the commanding side, with open shapes and no calligraphic shading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ar-one-sans: Distinctive and commanding, Bellota Text draws its curves without any pinching. AR One Sans, a plain sans with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, adds a modern softness beneath it.
